claims.claim: Cognition crossed US$1bn in annualised revenue run-rate on 25 September 2026.
claims.episode_span: The San Francisco lab crossed US$1bn in annualised revenue run-rate on 25 September 2026, up from US$492m in May, after raising more than US$2bn at a US$48bn valuation.
claims.source_title: Cognition: What is the Devin AI Coding Agent?
claims.supporting_quote: On 25 September 2026, the San Francisco lab crossed US$1bn in annualised revenue run-rate, according to a Bloomberg report, less than three years after it was founded and up from US$492m in May.

claims.episode_span: Exa released Exa 3.0, an upgrade to its web-search API for AI agents that adds a larger embedding model and a cheaper “lite” search type priced at $4 per 1,000 requests.
claims.source_title: Exa 3.0 Search API Tops Perplexity, Brave and Parallel on 8 Benchmarks
claims.supporting_quote: For developers, the practical change is cost: Lite costs $4 per 1,000 requests .

claims.claim: According to Anthropic, 82 percent of organizations have discovered unregistered agents in their network.
claims.episode_span: Most organisations lack basic visibility: according to Anthropic, 82% have discovered unregistered agents on their networks and 57% already run agents on multi-stage workflows.
claims.supporting_quote: According to Anthropic, 82 percent of organizations have discovered unregistered agents in their network, and 57 percent already deploy agents for multi-stage workflows.
